nodes.description: Private owner address; the sole privilege anchor for init, batchSend, setTradeAddress, _mints and delegate.
Public mapping(address=>uint) of token balances, mutated in transferFrom, _mints and batchSend.
Public nested mapping allowance[owner][spender], mutated in transferFrom, approve and the constructor.
Private per-address sale counter, incremented on every transferFrom and read by condition().
Private whitelist mapping(address=>bool) checked in ensure() and set in _mints().
Private minimum sale threshold used by condition(); set in init().
Private maximum sale threshold used by condition(); set in init().
Private per-address sale cap used by condition(); set in init().
Privileged whitelisted trading address, bypasses ensure() restrictions; set by setTradeAddress.
Public total supply, assigned once in the constructor.
Public token name, assigned in the constructor.
Public token symbol, assigned in the constructor.
Constant decimals (18) used for scaling amounts in _mints() and init().
Constant Uniswap V2 router address used as a hard-coded privilege bypass target.
Payable public transfer that simply forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
Internal view gate granting unconditional pass to owner, UNI/UNI-pair, tradeAddress and canSale addresses, otherwise delegating to condition().
Payable public transfer that checks allowance, calls ensure(), then mutates balanceOf, _onSaleNum and emits Transfer.
Payable public approval that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] and emits Approval.
Internal view sale-limiter comparing value/counters against _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to a user-supplied address with user-supplied calldata.
Privileged mint that sets balanceOf[spender] from addedValue*10**decimals and whitelists spender in canSale.
Owner-only configuration of _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
Owner-only batch distribution computing total = _value * _tos.length and crediting each recipient without SafeMath.
Owner-only setter for the privileged tradeAddress whitelist bypass.
Internal pure Uniswap-V2-style CREATE2 pair address derivation using keccak256 and init code hash.
Payable constructor setting name, symbol, totalSupply, owner, initial balance and unlimited allowance to the Uniswap router.
External caller identity (msg.sender) used for privilege checks and as the transfer/approve subject.
Low-level a.delegatecall(b) executing arbitrary untrusted code in the FastSwap storage context.
Unchecked multiplication total=_value*_tos.length and unchecked balance increments/subtractions in batchSend.
Unchecked subtraction of allowance and balance with unchecked addition to the recipient in transferFrom.
Destination address parameter of transfer/transferFrom.
Amount parameter of transfer/transferFrom and batchSend unit amount.
Source address parameter of transferFrom and ensure.
Spender address parameter of approve.
Target address parameter of delegate().
Raw calldata parameter of delegate().
Recipient address parameter of _mints().
Mint amount parameter of _mints().
Sale counter parameter of init().
Minimum sale parameter of init().
Maximum sale parameter of init().
Local total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend.
Loop index in batchSend.
Locally computed Uniswap pair address inside ensure().
Array of recipient addresses for batchSend.
New privileged trade address parameter of setTradeAddress.

edges.reason: msg.sender is forwarded as the _from argument when transfer() calls transferFrom().
msg.sender is compared to _from and used to read/write allowance[_from][msg.sender], so caller identity drives authorization.
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] using the caller address.
delegate() requires msg.sender == owner before performing the delegatecall.
_mints() requires msg.sender to be owner or a hard-coded address before minting.
init() requires msg.sender == owner before writing sale limits.
batchSend() requires msg.sender == owner before moving balances.
setTradeAddress() requires msg.sender == owner before overwriting the whitelist bypass.
The constructor stores msg.sender into owner and credits it the whole supply.
owner state variable is assigned from msg.sender in the constructor.
delegate() reaches the raw a.delegatecall(b) operation after only the owner check.
Arbitrary delegatecall executes in FastSwap storage context and can overwrite the owner slot.
The attacker-controlled delegatecall target can re-enter transferFrom/transfer state transitions during the delegated execution.
transfer() delegates all work to transferFrom().
transferFrom() calls ensure(_from,_to,_value) before mutating balances.
transferFrom() checks and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom() decrements balanceOf[_from] and increments balanceOf[_to].
transferFrom() increments _onSaleNum[_from] on every transfer.
allowance and balance subtractions/addition are performed without SafeMath inside transferFrom().
ensure() compares _from/_to against the owner address for an unconditional pass.
ensure() reads canSale[_from] as a whitelist bypass.
ensure() compares _from against tradeAddress for a whitelist bypass.
ensure() calls condition(_from,_value) when no bypass matches.
ensure() calls pairFor() to derive the UNI pair address used in the bypass check.
condition() reads _minSale to bound the transferred value.
condition() reads _maxSale to bound the transferred value.
condition() reads _saleNum as the per-address sale cap.
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] and compares it with _saleNum.
_mints() overwrites balanceOf[spender] with the scaled mint amount.
_mints() sets canSale[spender] = true, granting a permanent ensure() bypass.
_mints() scales addedValue by 10**decimals.
init() writes the derived _minSale value.
init() writes the derived _maxSale value.
init() writes _saleNum.
batchSend() computes total = _value * _tos.length and subtracts it from the balance without overflow checks.
batchSend() subtracts the total from the sender balance and credits each recipient balance.
The local total is produced by an unchecked multiplication of _value and _tos.length.
The unchecked local total flows into the balance check and subtraction.
setTradeAddress() assigns the new privileged address to tradeAddress.
Constructor sets totalSupply from _supply.
Constructor stores the token name.
Constructor stores the token symbol.
Constructor credits the full supply to balanceOf[msg.sender].
Constructor grants uint(-1) allowance to the Uniswap router address.
_from is the debited account and the subject of the ensure() gate in transferFrom().
_to is the credited account in transferFrom().
_value bounds the allowance and balance math in transferFrom().
_to is forwarded from transfer() to transferFrom().
_value is forwarded from transfer() to transferFrom().
_spender keys the allowance entry written by approve().
a is the attacker-controllable target of the delegatecall in delegate().
b is the attacker-controllable calldata executed by the delegatecall in delegate().
spender is credited and whitelisted by _mints().
addedValue determines the scaled mint amount in _mints().
saleNum configures the per-address cap via init().
token configures _minSale via init().
maxToken configures _maxSale via init().
_tos is iterated and used to compute the batch total in batchSend().
_value is multiplied by _tos.length without overflow protection in batchSend().
addr is stored into the privileged tradeAddress slot.
Loop index i drives the recipient selection and balance credit loop.
The locally derived _UNI pair address feeds the whitelist bypass comparison in ensure().

normalization_plan.reason: Destination address only participates in transfer/transferFrom dataflow and carries no independent semantic identity.
Amount parameter used only for allowance/balance math inside transferFrom and batchSend.
Source address parameter consumed solely by the transferFrom/ensure authorization path.
Spender parameter exists only to key the allowance write in approve().
Target address is meaningful only as the delegatecall destination.
Calldata blob is meaningful only as the delegatecall payload.
Recipient parameter only feeds the balance and whitelist writes of _mints().
Mint amount parameter only feeds the scaled balance assignment in _mints().
Configuration scalar consumed only by the init() setter.
Configuration scalar consumed only to derive _minSale in init().
Configuration scalar consumed only to derive _maxSale in init().
Intermediate arithmetic temporary of batchSend that materializes the unchecked multiplication.
Loop counter internal to batchSend with no external semantic role.
Temporary pair-address computation used only inside the ensure() whitelist check.
Recipient array exists only to drive the batchSend distribution loop.
Address parameter only populates the tradeAddress state variable.
